# Taven

> Taven is a free, privacy-first task manager and AI to-do list app for iPhone and iPad. It doesn't just organize your tasks — it tells you what to do next. Its on-device AI weighs importance, due dates and recurrence, then highlights your single most important task with a short reason (for example, "Due today and your top priority"). No account, no subscription, no data collection.

Key facts:

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS). Not available on Android, Windows, Mac or the web.
- Price: Free. No subscription. No in-app account.
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761032737
- Privacy: tasks are stored on the device, AI runs on-device, no third-party SDKs, zero data collected. Optional sync through the user's private iCloud account.
- Best for: people who feel overwhelmed by long to-do lists, struggle to decide what to work on, or want a private, no-subscription alternative to Todoist or TickTick.
- Not ideal for: team collaboration or shared projects, Android/Windows users, people who need many third-party integrations or a built-in Pomodoro timer.

## Features

- Intelligent prioritization: an "AI Suggested" task at the top of the day, chosen from importance, due dates and recurrence, with an explanation.
- Smart recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly and yearly tasks with optional end dates.
- Habits and streaks: every recurring task becomes a habit with its own streak and history; skipping a day doesn't lose track.
- Analytics: completion rings, weekly charts, monthly heatmaps, completion rate, best day and a "Today's Intensity" workload gauge.
- iCloud sync across the user's Apple devices (optional, private to the user).
- Personalization: accent colors and light, dark or system themes.
